title: Confirming a Ride Pickup
context: 乘客 Maya 和司机 Cole 通过叫车应用联系。Maya 在图书馆东门，Cole 原在西门；他们重新约在东门，并在上车前核对应用中的司机、车辆和目的地。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hello, this is Maya. Are you Cole, my driver?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是 Maya。你是我的司机 Cole 吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Yes, I am Cole. I am at the library west entrance.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我是 Cole。我在图书馆西门。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I am at the east entrance. Could you meet me here instead?
dialogue.zh: 我在东门。你能改到这里接我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Yes, I will drive around to the east entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thank you. I am beside the sign for the east entrance.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我在东门标志旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: I see the sign now, and I have stopped beside it.
dialogue.zh: 我现在看到标志了，已经停在旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Before I get in, my app shows Cole and a blue car. Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 上车前我确认一下：我的应用显示司机是 Cole，车是蓝色的。是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Yes. Please also check the license plate against your app.
dialogue.zh: 是的。也请你对照应用核对一下车牌。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The plate matches. What destination do you have?
dialogue.zh: 车牌一致。你看到的目的地是哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: The City Museum. Is that where you are going?
dialogue.zh: 市博物馆。你要去那里吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, that matches my app. I will get in now.
dialogue.zh: 对，和我应用里的一致。我现在上车。

dialogue.speaker: Cole
dialogue.en: Great. The door is unlocked. Welcome aboard.

expressions.zh: 上车地点；用于确认司机在哪里接乘客。
expressions.example: Is the east entrance your pickup location?

expressions.zh: 在这里接我或与我会合；可用来重新约地点。
expressions.example: Could you meet me here instead?

expressions.zh: 绕路开过去；用于车辆前往建筑物另一侧。
expressions.example: I will drive around to the east entrance.

expressions.zh: 车牌；上车前可与应用中的信息核对。
expressions.example: The license plate matches the app.

expressions.zh: 一致、相符；用于确认两处信息相同。

pronunciation: entrance /ˈɛntrəns/ 重音在第一音节；vehicle /ˈviːɪkəl/ 重音在第一音节。练习 license plate 时，license 的 c 读 /s/，plate 末尾的 /t/ 不要加元音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Getting around
practice.prompt: How do you usually travel to a new place?
practice.answer: I usually take a bus or request a ride. Before I leave, I check the pickup location and the destination.

practice.title: Part 2 · A journey
practice.prompt: Describe a journey when you had to arrange a pickup. Say where you were, how you communicated, and what happened.
practice.answer: Last weekend I requested a ride from a library to a museum. I waited at the east entrance, but the driver was at the west entrance. I told him where I was and asked him to meet me at the east entrance. Before getting in, I checked his name and the car and plate against the app. We also confirmed the destination, and then I got in. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Travel communication
practice.prompt: Why can a clear pickup location matter when people travel?
practice.answer: A clear location saves time and helps people find each other. A recognizable entrance or sign can be more useful than simply naming a large building.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先逐句跟读，再扮演乘客：说明入口不同，重新约定地点，上车前对照应用核对司机、车辆和目的地。
practice.answer: 用 4–6 句完成确认；同伴扮演司机，回应地点并说出目的地。
